    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices are higher than forecasts by ~0.5-1.5 on average",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price movements but model under-reacts to sentiment shifts",
    "Forecast lag exists - model fails to capture rapid price reversals as fast as reality",
    "Mean reversion bias - model over-predicts extremes that prices never fully reach",
    "Sentiment strength directly impacts forecast accuracy bias magnitude",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model under-forecasts more than when sentiment is neutral or positive",
    "Price level matters for bias - lower price ranges have more accurate forecasts than current ~78-80 range"
] }
